narr: A surface trough across the peninsula coupled with broad low- to mid-level inverted troughing over the eastern gulf enables moist south to southeast flow over the peninsula, leading to clusters of slow-moving, deep convection with heavy rain producing flash flooding in parts of Lee County during the early morning hours, and in parts of Pinellas County during the evening hours.
ev: Public reports received via social media depicted water rising into homes in the South Pasadena area due to heavy rainfall totaling 4 to 6 inches triggering instances of flash flooding.
